# dify_plugin_install (Resource)

Manages a plugin installation in the workspace. Only marketplace identifiers are supported (e.g. `langgenius/openai:0.3.8@<sha256>`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install a plugin from the Dify marketplace. The identifier is versioned:
# "<plugin>:<version>@<sha256>". Installation is asynchronous; the resource
# polls the install task until it completes.
resource "dify_plugin_install" "openai" {
  plugin_unique_identifier = "langgenius/openai:0.3.8@592c8252795b5f75807de2d609a03196ed02596b409f7642b4a07548c7ff57ef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_unique_identifier` (String) Versioned plugin identifier from the marketplace (e.g. `langgenius/openai:0.3.8@<sha256>`).

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Plugin category (e.g. `model`, `tool`).
- `plugin_id` (String) Plugin ID assigned by Dify (the identifier without the version, e.g. `langgenius/openai`).
- `version` (String) Installed plugin version.
